Synopsis:
Britain's PM Andy Burnham visited Kyiv announcing support for Ukraine's domestic long-range missile production, including sharing classified data on SCALP cruise missile components. The Kremlin condemned the move as escalatory, warning of consequences and accusing Britain of blocking peace progress. Russia claims it is actively targeting Ukrainian missile production sites. The episode marks a notable deepening of UK military involvement in the Ukraine conflict.
